name: transition
description: Token-aware easing/duration object. Accepts named easings (standard, emphasized, decelerate, accelerate, bounce) so motion stays consistent across primitives even when themes change.

props.name: delay
props.description: Delay before the animation starts, in milliseconds.

props.name: easing
props.description: Named easing token or any CSS easing string.

props.name: iterations
props.description: How many times the animation repeats. Defaults to 1.

ai.whenToUse: Use everywhere a motion timing is needed — Motion props, useAnimate calls, Timeline clips. Centralize timing here instead of inline numbers.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't use as a runtime config object — these values are static. For dynamic, runtime-driven motion use useMotionValue.
commonMistakes: Hard-coding ms numbers throughout the codebase instead of named easings — themes can't override them later.
Setting `duration: 0` to disable a transition; pass `initial={false}` on the host instead.
ai.accessibilityNotes: Always respects MotionConfig's reducedMotion mode at the engine level.
